name: Ordanus
summary: At Sunrock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand hunts Keeper Ordanus, an elder son of Cenarius who fled Stonetalon Peak. She believes his people desecrated ancient Highborne ruins, so she sends Horde champions across the border into Ashenvale to take his head.

sections.title: A Hunt Driven by Ancient Grudges
sections.body: Braelyn Firehand came to Stonetalon Mountains on her master's orders. She was sent to reclaim the sacred ruins of Azshara's ancient temples. At the peak, she found night elves treating relics of her Highborne forebears as wilderness to be contained. Keeper Ordanus escaped her and crossed into Ashenvale. Using arcane vision, Braelyn found him high in a wooden refuge at Raynewood Retreat, then enlisted the Horde to finish the hunt.

sections.title: The Scion of the Forest God
sections.body: Keeper Ordanus is counted among the eldest of Cenarius's sons, with deep ties to Kalimdor's wild magics. Night elf guardians moved him from Stonetalon Peak to Raynewood Retreat to shield him from arcane forces encroaching on sacred groves. Loyal Cenarion Vindicators and summoned woodland treants defend him. To Braelyn, Ordanus carries the forest demigod's ancient authority and stands in the way of her vengeance.

sections.title: Highborne Vengeance
sections.body: Braelyn Firehand seeks Ordanus's head for a personal grievance as well as her cause. She remembers knowing him centuries ago, when Cenarius's offspring looked down on the Highborne and their mastery of the arcane. Taking his head would avenge those old slights and clear a path for her master's deeper designs in Kalimdor's wilderness.

faq.answer: Keeper Ordanus is a keeper of the grove and one of Cenarius's eldest sons. First stationed near Stonetalon Peak, he fled into Ashenvale to escape Highborne vengeance.

faq.q: Where can Keeper Ordanus be found?
faq.answer: Keeper Ordanus lives atop a massive hollow tree structure at Raynewood Retreat, along the road through central Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Braelyn Firehand want Ordanus dead?
faq.answer: Braelyn sees the night elves' presence in Stonetalon as a desecration of ancient Highborne temple ruins. She also hates Ordanus for the arrogance and contempt she remembers from ages past.
Braelyn says her master sent her to Stonetalon Peak to reclaim Azshara's ancient temple ruins, but she guards the master's exact identity.

faq.q: How does this conflict fit into the Horde's presence in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Horde forces at Sunrock Retreat often clash with night elf sentinels and Cenarion protectors over territory and resources across Stonetalon and Ashenvale. Braelyn's strike against a Cenarion leader serves both sides' aims.

faq.q: What happens after Ordanus is slain?
faq.answer: After Ordanus dies, Braelyn rewards you and points you toward The Den, where threats across the Stonetalon peaks await.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you weaken night elf authority across the Ashenvale-Stonetalon border by striking down an elder son of Cenarius. This aids Horde expansion into contested timberlands.
As a mage, you may see Braelyn Firehand embody the Highborne's unyielding arcane pride and belief in arcane mastery over Cenarion natural philosophy.
As a druid of the Horde, you face a grim choice: take the life of a direct son of Cenarius to fulfill a blood elf's ancient feud.
